tone_and_style.principle: Be direct and technical in fix documentation
Explain what was fixed and why
Document the root cause of failure

requirement.name: Fix Summary
requirement.description: Document what was changed and why
requirement.template:
# Fix Summary ## Root Cause <Description of what caused the failure>
## Fix Applied <Description of the change made>
## Verification <How the fix was verified>

requirement.name: Trace Reference
requirement.description: Include trace file reference if used
requirement.example: # Trace: traces/test_login_trace.zip # Open with: playwright show-trace traces/test_login_trace.zip

requirement.name: Attempt Log
requirement.template: ## Healing Attempts 1. Attempt 1: <Fix tried> - <Result> 2. Attempt 2: <Fix tried> - <Result> 3. Attempt 3: <Fix tried> - <Result>
